newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB eyes stake in PLDT-led satellite group.
newsitem.headline: PNB eyes stake in PLDT-led satellite group.

text.p: Philippine National Bank (PNB) is eyeing a stake in the consortium led by the Phiippine Long Distance Telephone Co that will soon operate a $250 million satellite, a consortium official said on Thursday.
The official of Mabuhay Philippine Satellite Corp who asked not to be named said they were discussing the sale of a "minimal" amount of shares to PNB possibly from PLDT's stake.
PLDT has a 51 percent stake in Mabuhay.
At the same time, PNB is studying the lease of a transponder from Mabuhay to upgrade the bank's data transmission system.
A transponder is a satellite equipment that receives, processes and transmits communication and broadcast signals.
The official said the satellite, the Philippines' second, will finally be launched on August 8 after it was delayed from its original timetable in March.
Other consortium members are unlisted PT Pasifik Nusantara, China Everbright International Ltd and Philippine firms Republic Broadcasting Corp and the Philippine Communications Satellite Co Inc.
